requirements.criteria: Native events/labels/refs/form/required/UTF-16 maxlength/readOnly and single-value selector
Disabled/loading click/Enter/Space/implicit submit/rapid actions; held real PUT retry exactly once; no automatic AI
Persistent long errors and retry/backup/conflict controls, separate unmeasured and record completion, progress0/100, 12px saved status, original message lifetime

checks.command: node --check + eslint changed QA after final readiness correction

recoveryHistory.finding: TextArea maxLength is a soft counter; previous native UTF-16 limits and required must survive
recoveryHistory.resolution: Map htmlMaxLength and native required/lang/form; emoji and SSR contract checks

recoveryHistory.finding: Core required marker changed accessible names; selector inner trigger was shorter than44px
recoveryHistory.resolution: Preserve original aria-label and apply44px to the actual combobox button; do not exclude it from the touch audit

recoveryHistory.finding: Banner error styling does not imply role=alert, and nested progress track collapsed with100% height
recoveryHistory.resolution: Explicit urgent role; persistent uncollapsed banner; public track4/8px and0/100 checks

recoveryHistory.finding: Core Text changed saved status to16px/ink/block
recoveryHistory.resolution: Scoped12px/caption/flex restoration; real home computed styles on both widths and engines

recoveryHistory.finding: Older AI QA omitted required Korean intention and used stale v7/v6 synthetic replies
recoveryHistory.resolution: Explicit synthetic intention and existing currentOpenaiFeedback helper; preserve request counts, original text, outcomes and receipts

recoveryHistory.finding: WebKit key press raced async context identity readiness
recoveryHistory.resolution: Wait for the actual request button to enable; assert zero automatic calls before pressing Enter

recoveryHistory.finding: New global retry QA assumed an error button stayed mounted while saving and sent keys to restored page focus
recoveryHistory.resolution: Assert existing error-to-saving transition and exactly one held PUT after three clicks; busy keyboard behavior is independently tested in the common contract fixture

limits: No deployment/GitHub write/paid AI/production QA writes
WebKit emulation is not actual iPhone/IME/VoiceOver
Single-value Selector adapter is not a blanket native required/multiple/form/ref substitute
Programmatic form.requestSubmit and direct API calls still require domain safeguards
No pixel identity or final performance certification claim

completionAudit.ownedWorkerCheck: No matching process after runner completion; lock absent
